profile.headline: iOS developer at Valormill
profile.summary:
I'm always curious, and always eager to learn. 
Fluent in English, Spanish and German. Learning French.
. . .
Studied Art and German, then transitioned to sales at Lewis & Clark Outfitters. I have 5 years of experience in sales and management, and in helping to grow brands like Hoka at a time when they were relatively not well known. 
. . .
Leveraged my skills in German to intern with the Events & Communications department at the Global Hilti HQ. Helped in adapting events that would normally be live into digital events. 
. . .
Leveraging my curiosity, I joined a local start up as an iOS mobile app developer. 
Learned how to program in Swift (iOS) from 0 knowledge and developed two apps in the span of 2.5 years, both of which communicate and interact with a physical electronics product. 
Gained experience in the full development process from ideation, proposal, wireframing, UX/UI design, understanding of the final product, sales and marketing, and pivoting to accommodate changes from the client. 
Leveraged my experience in management and helped to grow the company from 3 - 10 employees through hiring and the development of sales processes and  SOPs.
. . .
On the side I've created two children's books, I've launched an NFT collection, and created the marketing strategy for an app to help children who struggle with Dyslexia and ADHD.

- Learned how to program in Swift (iOS) from 0 knowledge and developed two apps in the span of 2.5 years, both of which communicate and interact with a physical electronics product. 
- Experience in the full development process from ideation, proposal, wireframing, UX/UI design, understanding of the final product, sales and marketing, and pivoting to accommodate changes from the client. 
- Helped to grow the company from 3 - 10 employees through hiring and the development of sales processes and  SOPs.
positions.insights: Skills: Leadership · iOS Development · Swift (Programming Language) · Business Development

positions.title: Events Team Intern
positions.description:
-Adapted and hosted events from a traditional setting into a digital setting for up to 1,000 attendants. 
-Coordinated events for employees of all Hiliti branches and Business Units in different time zones, as well as local events.
-Created video content for training and information for new and future Hilti employees.

positions.title: Footwear manager
positions.description:
-Consistently led sales growth in the company through:
-Empowering outfitters. 
-Efficient social media advertising.
-Creative customer involvement and events and effective use of retail space.

positions.title: Translator
positions.description:
-Translated legal documents from Spanish to English for court cases.
-Served as interpreter for clients who could not speak English when needed. 
-Welcomed new clients.
-Performed organizational secretary duties.

positions.title: Taco Builder
positions.description:
- Helped launch the fourth branch of a rapidly growing franchise model. 
- Helped streamline the process of cooking, closing and opening duties, as well as customer service.

positions.title: Counselor
positions.description:
-Served summers of 2011, 2012, 2013, 2016.
-Served as counselor leadership for other counselors to maintain Camp War Eagle's standards.
-Served as part of Ozone throughout, CWE's year-round program.

volunteerExperiences.description: Ozone is the year round follow-up program that Camp War Eagle has. The purpose is to give the kids that went to summer camp the same fun experience throughout the year. As counselor volunteers we help set up games, keep order, encourage great relationships among kids, and help clean after the event ends as well as help plan future meetings.

Sin Limites is a club for Hispanic children of J. O. Kelley middle school in Springdale, AR. who don't know how to read, write, or even speak Spanish. The purpose is to teach the kids the importance of mastering the language and the many doors that it can open to them. I have presented lectures and performed rap songs as well as been in dance performances with the kids to empower them and guide them in the many ways and culture that the Spanish language links us to.

organizations.description: Doubled membership through strategic target marketing after my becoming an officer in Spring 2015
